title: Last year I got to see @dollymusical during its world premiere in Nas...
transcript: DOLLY: A True Original Musical is coming to Broadway and I can't wait to see it again. Last year I got to see the world premiere in the land of Dolly Parton herself, Nashville, Tennessee, and it was such a special experience. One of my favorite things to do as a theatre fan is to see a show when it's out of town. If you're not familiar, that's when a show premieres somewhere outside of New York City. This is like a really incredible way for shows to develop, because they get to perform an entire run in front of an audience. They can figure out what works and what doesn't. It gives them time to refine, and then when they're ready, they can come to Broadway. And Dolly is premiering this December at the St James Theatre, and it's opening on Dolly Parton's 81st birthday. What I really loved about the show in Nashville is you got to learn so much about Dolly Parton outside of her career. You got to see her warmth and her humor and her resilience and her big heart. all of the things that make her so beloved. I mean, literally, the tagline of the musical is, the rhinestones were never the whole story, and that is so true. And you also get all of your favorite Dolly Parton songs on stage, like Jolene and 9 to 5 and coat of many colors and I will always love you. But you also get new Dolly Parton Music cause she's written new songs for the show. I just genuinely love Dolly Parton so much, and I'm so excited for this show to finally be on Broadway. Tickets are on sale to everyone as of July 10th.
